bridge_functions.name: ItemScanner.Availability
bridge_functions.description: Whether the on-device model can identify items in photos (synchronous)

bridge_functions.name: ItemScanner.Identify
bridge_functions.description: Identify the item in a photo (async, emits ItemIdentified or IdentificationFailed)

bridge_functions.name: ItemScanner.Capture
bridge_functions.description: Open a camera that stays up between shots (emits PhotoCaptured per photo, ItemRepeated per +1, or CaptureFailed)

bridge_functions.name: ItemScanner.WhenUncovered
bridge_functions.description: Wait until nothing is presented over the app, such as a closing camera (emits ScreenUncovered)
